David spends the afternoon with the tree with compound leaves and hard nuts — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.

Ella was watching. Now they know Hickory Nuts too.

— DAY 5 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
